integrity: The exact penalty map and cycling threshold are proved algebraically. A standalone exact-rational checker replays the stated update identities and representative stabilization/cycle cases. The known fixed-penalty optimizer is attributed to prior work rather than presented as new.
scientific_limitations: Scalar strongly convex quadratic; classical primal/dual residuals; symmetric multiplicative residual-balancing factor. The theorem concerns exact arithmetic and does not assert typical large-scale behavior. A later 2024 quadratic adaptive-penalty paper was identified but its full text was not inspected, leaving a stated originality risk.
title: Exact deadband and sharp cycling threshold for residual-balancing ADMM
